_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Weight Handling Procedures
summary: Establishes the format and content for contractor certification of compliance with weight handling procedures for on-site delivery and installation of equipment.
use_relationship:
This certification of compliance with weight handling procedures applies to contractor personnel whose duties include the operation and use of all weight handling equipment for the on-site delivery and installation of a Hydraulic Actuator Test Stand (HATS) and any associated deliverables.  The operation of all weight handling equipment shall adhere to NAVFAC P-307 (June 2016) Weight Handling Program Management. Applicable sections from P-307 include Section 11, 14 and Appendix P. The contractor shall prepare the "Certificate of Compliance" and the "Contractor Crane or Rigging Operation Checklist" in Appendix B.  Prior to installation of equipment, a Lift Plan shall be provided by the contractor and approved by Government Weight Handling Team.  The Lift Plan shall meet all requirements as listed in NAVFAC P-307 Section 11 Part G.

This Data Item Description contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting for the work task described by the contract SOW.
